indent.description: The text used for indentation. If this value is set to null, no indentation will be done.

newline.description: The text used for newline. Cannot be null.

space.description: The text used for a single white space. Cannot be null.

wrapColumn.description:
The maximum width of a line, after which longer lines will wrap to the next. If this value is set to null, no
wrapping will be done.

multiWordKwSnakeCase.description: Whether to output multi-word keywords (`schema name`) by replacing the spaces with underscores.

skipComments.description: Whether to suppress all comments (including documentation).

nonDocComments.description: Whether to output non-documentation comments, such as to-do and other internal ones.

name: DslPrintSpec
